extensionDescription.message: Find media on the active webpage and download it locally with a separate Windows x64 component.

restoreDefaultDirectory.message: Leave blank to restore the default folder

autoSiteNote.message: Media on this domain and its subdomains will be selected automatically when scanned.

privacyDisclosure.message: The current page is read only after you start a scan. Previews, size checks, and downloads contact media servers. Previews do not use your website sign-in. Some formats, protected media, or servers that block anonymous cross-origin access cannot be previewed.

hostDescriptionWindows.message: Scanning works without installation. Downloads need the Windows 10/11 x64 component (download service, yt-dlp, and FFmpeg). Python is not required.

hostDescriptionUnsupported.message: Scanning and selecting media are still available. The local download component supports Windows 10/11 x64 only, so downloads, size checks, and local task management are unavailable on this system.

hostSetupStep1.message: Download and run the Windows x64 component installer. Administrator rights are not required.

hostSetupStep2.message: This extension will connect automatically when installation finishes.

hostInstallPendingDescription.message: Open the installer you just downloaded and finish setup. This extension will connect automatically.

hostInstallPendingStep1.message: If the installer is still downloading, save it and run it when ready.

hostInstallPendingStep2.message: You won't need to retry manually; the extension will detect and connect to the component.

uninstallNote.message: Uninstall the component from Windows Installed apps; tasks and videos are kept. Uninstall the browser extension separately.

scanPrompt.message: Select Scan this page to find video media

cookieDisclosure.message: Off by default. When enabled, cookies for selected media sites are read and access is requested when needed.

backgroundUnavailable.message: The extension background is temporarily unavailable. Close the popup and try again, or reload the extension from Edge extensions.

backgroundNoResponse.message: The extension background did not respond. Close the popup and try again.

errorDownloadFailed.message: Download failed. Check that the media is still accessible, then scan again and retry.

errorHostToolsMissing.message: The local component is incomplete. Reinstall or repair it.

errorWorkerStart.message: The local download task could not start. Retry, or repair the local component if the problem continues.

errorCookieAuthorization.message: This task needs renewed permission to use the website sign-in.

errorTaskNotResumable.message: This task cannot resume. Scan again and create a new task.

errorSizeProbe.message: The media size could not be checked.

errorMediaUrl.message: The media link could not be identified. Scan the page again and retry.

errorTaskRunning.message: This task is already running. Wait or refresh the task list.

errorHttpMediaOnly.message: This media address is not supported. Scan for a directly accessible HTTP or HTTPS video link.

errorMediaType.message: This media format is not supported for download.

errorPrivateAddress.message: For security, local and private-network media addresses cannot be accessed.

errorDownloadFolderType.message: The selected download location is not a folder. Choose another location.

errorDownloadFolderCreate.message: The download folder could not be created. Check the path and disk permissions.

systemNoDownloads.message: Downloads are not supported on this system

hostNotStarted.message: Local download service is not running

privatePreviewBlocked.message: Local network media is not previewed

formatPreviewUnsupported.message: Preview is not supported for this format

previewTimedOut.message: Preview timed out. Scan again to retry.

noMediaFound.message: No directly downloadable video links were found. Try playing the video before scanning. Blob, DRM-protected, and temporary links may not be identifiable.

installWindowsForSize.message: Install the Windows component to check the size

sizeProbeStartFailed.message: Could not start checking media sizes. Refresh and try again.

openTaskFolderTitle.message: Open the folder containing this task's file

deleteTaskConfirm.message: Delete $1 and its downloaded file and temporary data?

hostRequiredNotice.message: Install the local component first; this extension will connect automatically when setup finishes. Scanning, previewing, and selecting still work.

unknownResource.message: This media address could not be identified

duplicateRendition.message: Another quality of this video is already selected

downloadQueueAdded.message: Added $1 items to the download queue

invalidDomain.message: Enter a valid domain, such as media.example.com

siteAlreadyAllowed.message: This site is already on the allowlist

installHostForFolder.message: Install the local component to set a download folder

hostNotConnectedFolder.message: The local component is not connected, so its default folder cannot be read

pathTooLong.message: Paths must be 260 characters or fewer and cannot contain control characters

absolutePathRequired.message: Enter an absolute path, such as D:\Videos

bridgeProtocolMismatch.message: Local component protocol mismatch (v$1; v$2 required)

bridgeProtocolMismatchAction.message: Download and run the local component installer to update it; this extension will reconnect automatically. If the component is newer, update the store extension too.

bridgeHostVersionMismatch.message: Update the local component to version $1 or later

bridgeNotInstalled.message: The local download service is not installed or registered

bridgeNotInstalledAction.message: Scanning still works. Download and run the Windows x64 component installer; this extension will connect automatically when setup finishes.

bridgeAccessDenied.message: Could not start the local service because access was denied

bridgeAccessDeniedAction.message: Repair the local component with the official installer and check whether browser policies or security software block the connection. Administrator installation is not required.

bridgeHostExited.message: The local download service has exited

bridgeHostExitedAction.message: Select Retry connection. If the problem continues, download and run the installer to repair the component.

bridgeUnavailable.message: The local download component is temporarily unavailable

bridgeUnavailableAction.message: Select Retry connection. If the problem continues, download and run the installer to repair the component or contact support.

bridgeHostInUse.message: The local component is in use by another browser

bridgeHostInUseAction.message: Select Stop service in the other browser extension, then retry here.

bridgeIdle.message: The local download service is not running

workerUnsupportedPage.message: This page cannot be scanned. Switch to a regular HTTP or HTTPS webpage.

workerStopped.message: The local download service has stopped

workerTimeout.message: The local component timed out while handling $1

cookiePermissionDenied.message: Permission to use sign-in cookies for $1 was not granted. The task was not started.

cookiePermissionInactive.message: Permission for $1 did not take effect. The task was not started.
